'''Tozzin Foods''' was a company specializing in the production of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] and had offices located in the [[Elrood Bazaar]]. Their chief competitor was [[Attakril Meats]].
